scope: one preregistered N64 material-union control, same given smooth shear D=.02,T=.05; originalN128/N256 states reused
union: original2x2 N128 material groups; mass=sum original mass,c0=sum original m*c0/new union mass; original data never modified
pure_point_phase: original N128 label centers grouped geometrically; original prescribed map; rho0=1+.25cos(2pi a), both old grids verified bitwise before use
common_observation: direct raw child component sums from each native grid divided by same new physical N64 union mass; ratio2 and ratio4 direct, no intermediate mass normalization
common_denominator: new union initial mass-fluctuation norm, used for all common and native error numerators; original native denominators additionally reported
common_state_indicator: adjacent grids'8/16 common differences +2*(union reference space+time norms) +each grid native-reference-to-union difference +three initial bridges +projected cumulative machine/tail allowances of both8/16 at both grids +observed independent sequence differences
common_initial_bridges: union reference0-minus-unionc0, finer projectedc0-minus-unionc0, finer projected reference0-minus-finer projectedc0
common_H_indicator: adjacent8/16 H differences +2*reference space/time H differences +both reference projection H differences +three initial H bridges +observed solver H differences +(2sqrt(total_union_mass)*max(1,maxabs(unionc0))*absolute_solver_indicator+indicator^2)/union_initial_variance
native_state_indicator: both grids' native8/16 differences +2*sum of both native reference space/time norms +both native initial reference bridges +both grids' cumulative8/16 machine/tail allowances +native observed independent sequence differences,all divided by common initial norm
reference_H_time_base: space difference compares M63-k128 versus M127-k128; time difference is M127-k128 minus best M127-k256; raw reconstructions only for indicators
decision: both adjacent pairs at both nonzero times require common concentration,common H and native concentration error gains greater than their fixed indicators; else inconclusive/adverse
orders: record raw error ratios and log2 observations separately for native/common; no general theorem,remaining error certification or extrapolated state
stop: no automatic new grid,K32,D/flow,state/mass/geometry/weight change or threshold relaxation
